title: 第二百七十四章 肥膘阁主第二百七十三章 暗界领域
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑被蒙着头，她也不知被带向何处，也不知走了多久，缓缓的被身旁的人拉停了下来……
她隐隐约约听到好些女生欢快的声音，伴随着一个男子的愉悦声。
“咯吱——”一声…
门开了的声音，那些女子和男子的声音更加清晰了，她被带了进去，那些声音突然安静了下来。
随后听见身旁的人说道：“阁主，这里有个擅闯暗阁的人。”
“打开看看！”
昔小苑眼前突然明亮了起来，眼睛有些适应不了缓缓的眯着眼，适应后只见肥得流油的一男子和两三个女子在卿卿我我的。
可见这就是地主样吧，一个水桶肚，下巴的肉都有几层了，可见这油水肯定富的很。
阁主毒辣的眼神看着她，走了过来围绕着她走了一圈，细细的打量着，而后喃喃自语道：“身子还挺瘦小…...”
昔小苑一脸无感的看向他，听见他又自语道：“长得真标致。”
一旁手下突然道：“回阁主，‘她’是男子。”
那一身肥膘油腻的阁主一脸意味不明的坏笑，道：“就好这口~”
那手下忍不住鸡皮疙瘩，内心：真怕阁主哪天对自己感兴趣！
肥膘阁主猛的抓起昔小苑的手，她被这突如其来的举动身子惊了一下……
而后他很是满意的说道：“不错不错~”
一旁的手下很会看脸色的对那些女子使了个眼色默默退去，那些女子还一脸不满的走了，一边走还一边不忘喃喃自语道：“这男的也不怎么样嘛…哼！”
屋里现只剩下昔小苑与这肥膘阁主，紧接着就是“咯吱”一声的关门声，屋里顿时就安静的很，她竟还有点紧张了。
她掩饰不住一脸厌恶的眼神看着他，什么玩意儿，竟然‘男’的也不放过，真是好色成性呀！！
肥膘阁主色眯眯的就往她抱去，她立马身手灵敏的一躲，顺势一脚踹他屁股上，他顿时一身肥肉止不住的往前扑去……
只见他踉踉跄跄的想站稳，可还是扑倒在地。

昔小苑忍俊不禁的大笑了起来，道：“哈哈哈哈，笑死。”
肥膘阁主随后吃力的爬了起来，大怒道：“你个贱人，找死！！！”
他起身后奋力的一拳向她挥去……
昔小苑一脸冷漠的模样，顿时迅速一躲反脚就是一踹。
“啊！”
‘彭——’得一声，肥膘阁主又是扑街在地。
昔小苑忍不住又大笑起来，道：“哈哈哈哈，你真的好滑稽，打架都费劲吧？！”
肥膘阁主因脸着地，现在他抬头便是一张摔得脸青鼻肿的样，鼻子还流血了......
他抹了抹鼻子发现手上都是血，眼睛都气红了，而且还躺在地上起不来了......
他从来没有这么憋屈过！越想就越气，顿时立马大吼道：“来人啊！杀了这不要脸的东西！！”.
话落，顿时一群人冒了出来，他们是从窗户和门以及房梁上一溜烟的时间直接到达现场。
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan's head was covered. She didn't know where she was being taken or how long she had been walking. She was slowly pulled to a stop by the person next to her...
She vaguely heard the cheerful voices of many girls, accompanied by the cheerful voice of a man.
"Creak——" a sound...
The sound of the door opening became clearer, and the voices of the women and men became clearer. She was brought in, and the voices suddenly became quiet.
Then I heard the person next to me say: "Pavilion Master, there is a person here who breaks into the secret pavilion without permission."
"Open it and take a look!"
Xi Xiaoyuan's eyes suddenly brightened up, and he slowly squinted his eyes as he couldn't adapt. After adjusting, he saw a very fat man and two or three women making love to each other.
It can be seen that this is like a landlord, with a bucket belly and several layers of meat on the chin, which shows that he must be very rich in oil and water.
The master of the pavilion looked at her with vicious eyes, walked over and walked around her, looked at her carefully, and then murmured to himself: "She is quite thin..."
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at him with an expression of indifference, and heard him say to himself: "You are so beautiful."
A subordinate on the side suddenly said: "Back to the Pavilion Master, 'she' is a man."
The fat and greasy pavilion master had an unclear evil smile on his face and said, "This is the best~"
The subordinate couldn't help but feel goosebumps, thinking in his heart: I'm really afraid that the Pavilion Master will be interested in me one day!
The Master of Fatty Pavilion suddenly grabbed Xi Xiaoyuan's hand, and she was startled by this sudden move...
Then he said with great satisfaction: "Not bad, not bad~"
The men on the side winked at the women and silently retreated. The women walked away with dissatisfied expressions on their faces. As they walked away, they did not forget to mutter to themselves: "This man is not very good... Humph!"
Only Xi Xiaoyuan and the fat pavilion master were left in the room, and then there was a "squeaking" sound of the door closing. The room suddenly became very quiet, and she was actually a little nervous.
She couldn't hide the look of disgust on her face and looked at him. She didn't even let the 'male' go free, she was so lustful! !
The Master of the Fatty Pavilion looked at her with a sultry expression, and he hugged her. She immediately ducked out of the way and kicked him on the butt. He suddenly couldn't help but pounce forward...
I saw him staggering and trying to stand still, but he still fell to the ground.
Xi Xiaoyuan couldn't help laughing and said: "Hahahaha, I'm laughing to death."
The Fatty Pavilion Master then struggled to get up and said angrily: "You bitch, you are looking for death!!!"
After he stood up, he punched her hard...
Xi Xiaoyuan looked indifferent and quickly dodged and kicked.
"Ah!"
With a sound of "Peng——", the master of Fat Fat Pavilion threw himself on the street again.
Xi Xiaoyuan couldn't help but laughed again and said: "Hahahaha, you are so funny, you have to fight hard, right?!"
The Fatty Pavilion Master landed on his face, and now he looks up with a bruised face and swollen nose, and his nose is bleeding...
He wiped his nose and found that his hands were covered with blood, his eyes were red with anger, and he was lying on the ground unable to get up...
He has never been so frustrated! The more he thought about it, the angrier he became, and he immediately shouted: "Here comes someone! Kill this shameless thing!!".
As soon as the words fell, a group of people suddenly appeared. They arrived at the scene directly from the windows, doors and beams.
